note: The derivation graph behind [E.3] 'reuse by input hash'. E.3 has been written down since v5 but never implemented — no artifact stored the hash of its inputs, so 'recompute only downstream of the change' had nothing to compute from, and any veto meant a full rebuild. This file states what derives from what; dops_hash.py records and verifies it.

input_forms.contract:<section>: sha256 of that top-level block of artifacts/design-contract.yaml

skeleton.html.note: structure derives from the information model, never from taste [A.3]

index.html.note: the shipped page when a project has no separate skeleton file

artifacts/visual/tokens.json.note: a direction change re-derives tokens; a structure change does not

artifacts/visual/tokens.css.note: compiled output — a hand edit here is drift [A.10], not a change

artifacts/audit/floor.json.note: the verdict is only as fresh as what it was measured against
